economic_hypothesis: Portfolio-level breadth, dispersion and activity states can time a diversified liquid basket more robustly than repeatedly selecting idiosyncratic extremes, reducing event noise and transaction-cost sensitivity.

portfolio_state_families.broad_oversold_liquid_rebound: median ret3<-0.3%, positive breadth<35%, buy most liquid names
portfolio_state_families.breadth_thrust_liquid_leaders: median ret3>0.2%, positive breadth>65%, buy liquid positive leaders
portfolio_state_families.high_dispersion_relative_winners: dispersion above training q75, buy liquid top ret1 ranks
portfolio_state_families.high_dispersion_loser_reclaims: dispersion above training q75, bottom-decile ret3 and current ret1>0
portfolio_state_families.concentrated_activity_liquid_leaders: top-10 volume share>20%, buy liquid positive leaders

hard_gates.native_factory_null: run only after all pre-null gates
